title: Eligibility Category Additions to Prior Authorization Transition-of-Care Units
content:
**Rule.** The population addition of a transition-of-care request follows the member's eligibility category: Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care adds six units; Prairie Ridge ABD Care or Prairie Ridge Dual Complete adds two units; any other category adds nothing.

This addition applies to the units a Prior Authorization transition-of-care request asks for. It is made once, before the ceiling of the class's most units per approval is applied. The eligibility category is the one assigned by the state on the member's Medicaid Managed Care Membership.

## Category table

| Eligibility category on the membership | Units added to the transition-of-care request |
|---|---|
| Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care | 6 |
| Prairie Ridge ABD Care | 2 |
| Prairie Ridge Dual Complete | 2 |
| Prairie Ridge Expansion Adult | 0 |
| Prairie Ridge Family Care | 0 |
| Prairie Ridge CHIP Kids | 0 |
| Prairie Ridge Children's Medicaid | 0 |

## Basis questions

**Does the service or the class change the addition?** No. The addition turns only on the eligibility category.

**Hypothetical:** a member enrolled in Prairie Ridge Dual Complete receives an addition of 2 units on a transition-of-care request; a member in Prairie Ridge Family Care receives none.
